# agents.AgentRequestContext

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Per-run context every agent, tool and workflow reads: tenant, caller, effective permissions and regional settings.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.AgentRequestContext` |
| Kind | `settings` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `activeScreen` | no | `none` | Route id of the UI screen the caller is on. |  |
| `aiMode` | yes | `none` | Whether models are real providers or the deterministic fakes. |  |
| `conversationId` | no | `none` | Chat conversation id; also the memory thread id. |  |
| `currency` | yes | `none` | Default ISO 4217 currency of the active node. |  |
| `displayTimeZone` | yes | `none` | IANA time zone used to show dates to the caller. |  |
| `locale` | yes | `none` | BCP 47 locale for answers and formatting. |  |
| `nodeTimeZone` | yes | `none` | IANA time zone of the active node, for calendar rules. |  |
| `organizationId` | yes | `none` | Same value as tenantId; the key Mastra TokenCostControl reads. |  |
| `permissions` | yes | `none` | Effective permissions: principal grants intersected with the agent ceiling. |  |
| `principalKind` | yes | `none` | Whether a person or an API key made the call. |  |
| `projectId` | no | `none` | Active project, when the request is scoped to one. |  |
| `requestId` | yes | `none` | X-Request-Id of the /v1 call (ULID). |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Active organization; from the verified principal, never from the client body. |  |
| `unitId` | no | `none` | Active unit, when the request is scoped to one. |  |
| `userId` | yes | `personal` | Firebase Auth uid of the caller (API key owner for services). |  |
